## F1 (XF B1, absent record): grade tiers enumerate grades, but compute also prices "no enrolled district record". Policies care_ext_late_pickup_fee_schedule and care_ext_booked_day_fee_schedule.
- care_ext_late_pickup_fee_schedule rule (yaml line 1156): "The schedule's per-minute rate follows the grade on the student's district enrollment record for the enrollment's school year in status enrolled: pk_rate for grade PK3 or PK4, kg_rate for grade KG, and late_pickup_fee_per_minute for grades 01 through 05."
  ladder (1204-1209): "...shows grade PK3 or PK4" / "it shows grade KG" / "it shows grade 01 through 05".
  compute (1170-1171): `district_grade: CFIELD('enroll','grade_level', student_id=F('student_id'), school_year=F('school_year'), status='enrolled')`; `grade_rate: K('pk_rate') if district_grade in K('pk_grades') else (K('kg_rate') if ... else P('late_pickup_fee_per_minute'))`. The else branch also covers district_grade == None, meaning no record in status enrolled for the school year (for example a district withdrawal recorded after the pickup).
- care_ext_booked_day_fee_schedule rule (1457): "The schedule's grade supplement follows the grade on the student's district enrollment record for the enrollment's school year in status enrolled: pk_supplement for grade PK3 or PK4, kg_supplement for grade KG, and nothing for grades 01 through 05."
  compute (1474-1475): the same CFIELD; `grade_supplement: ... else 0`. None therefore gives 0.
- Mismatch: when the student has no enrolled district record for the school year, the rule's tiers are silent and the reader has no rate or supplement. Compute gives the 01-05 value. Rendering the three tiers verbatim leaves that world undetermined, and adding "otherwise" would add law. The sibling policy care_ext_notice_period_credit already states this case outright ("in every other case, a student with no district enrollment record for the school year included, ..."). Fix needed in the rule and ladder: name the fall-through, e.g. "...and late_pickup_fee_per_minute for grades 01 through 05 and for a student with no such record", and the same shape for the supplement. Reachability: low (care starts only with an enrolled record, and a district withdrawal ends care), but it is the B1 absent-record probe.

## F2 (XF B1, absent record): CCS credit base when no board remittance has ever posted. Policy care_ext_notice_period_credit.
- rule (1819): "The credit base is the family's share of the charge for an enrollment funded through Workforce Solutions Child Care Services: the charge less the board remittance posted for that billing month when one has posted, and the charge less the enrollment's most recent board remittance when none has posted for that month yet; for any other enrollment it is the whole charge."
  ladder (1927-1928): "it is so funded and no board remittance has posted for that month yet" -> "the charge less the enrollment's most recent board remittance".
  compute (1842-1843): `recent_remittance: LATEST('care_ledger','amount', ..., event_type='care_subsidy_remittance')`; `credit_base: ... ((final_charge - (recent_remittance if recent_remittance != None else 0)) if (ccs_funded == 'workforce_solutions_ccs' and month_remittance == 0) ...`.
- Mismatch: for a CCS-funded enrollment that has never had a remittance posted (an authorization that started in the final month), "the enrollment's most recent board remittance" does not exist. The rule gives no credit base, while compute uses the whole charge. Fix needed: state the case, e.g. "...when none has posted for that month yet, and the whole charge when no board remittance has posted on the enrollment at all", in the rule and the tier.

## Observations (not counted as mismatches; the coordinator decides)
- O1 (C4 scope, care_ext_booked_day_fee_schedule): rule (1449) "...a booking on an enrollment of any other school year is charged under the day-fee sentences below as they stand for that year" (those sentences give drop_in_day_fee / holiday_camp_day_fee / early_release_day_fee), but `result` (1482) is 0 unless `F('school_year') == K('schedule_year')`. This reads as a stated scope test ("This policy prices ... of an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year, and only of such an enrollment"), so I treat it as acceptable. Note that the two sibling fee policies do price their out-of-year case (they return the standard fee).
- O2 (XF B2 decoy, no status filter on care_requests): care_requests has request_status received | completed | declined | cancelled. care_ext_booked_day_fee_schedule (1467, 1476, 1478, 1479) and care_ext_notice_period_credit (1830-1832, 1838) select the latest drop_in_booking / withdrawal_notice by created_at with no status filter. The rules ("the most recent drop-in booking request", "the enrollment's most recent withdrawal_notice request") agree with this literally, so it is not a rule-vs-compute mismatch. But a cancelled or declined latest request would be priced or credited, and the booked-day prerequisite of care_ext_current_year_payment_plan inherits that.
